messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on inference-gateway (svc=infer-gw-prod). 1m error rate 18% (baseline <0.5%). 자동 reroute attempted -> 3/5 fallbacks failed. Pager triggered.

aaron (oncall): ack, joining. seeing spike on dashboards. routing errors -> 502/504.

marta (eng-runtime): logs from model-runner show repeated process exits, kernel messages point to oom/abort before 5xx flood. attaching recent tail: ```May 5 03:20:12 runner-3 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 3412 (model-worker) score 987 or sacrifice child
May 5 03:20:12 runner-3 kernel: model-worker[3412]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f... sp 00007ffd... error 4 in libattention.so```

jun (ml-oncall): this looks like allocator blowup when kv-cache growth + long sequences hit quant path. We recently rolled quant-optimized kernels on these hosts.

priya (sre-lead): immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable quant kernel variant for the affected model routing 2) scale down incoming traffic via emergency rate-limit on infer-gw-prod 3) drain affected node pool and evict pods 4) enable fallback small-model-route to keep latency but reduce OOM chance.

aaron (oncall): executing step 2 -> `curl -X POST https://console/api/rate-limit -d '{"svc":"infer-gw-prod","limit":0.3}'` -> done, inbound traffic dropped ~60%. error rate dropped to 11% but still noisy.

marta (eng-runtime): rolling runtime config: `rbacctl set model.variant disabled --model-id gptx-quant-2b` -> applying to cluster. Also toggling KV cache eviction to aggressive: `kvctl set eviction_threshold 0.6`.

jun (ml-oncall): patch applied to routing, running healthchecks. Early telemetry: per-pod memory growth stabilized on patched nodes.

support-ops: customer-impact note -> Zendesk alert: ~120 tickets in last 30m, most timeouts on batched embed requests. tagging high-severity customers (top 10).

aaron (oncall): starting node drain on nodepool-infer-a (3 nodes). `kubectl drain nodepool-infer-a-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> in progress.

priya (sre-lead): assign hotfix handoff: marta, please lead runtime patch + rollback plan. After mitigation complete I will take over post-mortem + RCA tracking.

marta (eng-runtime): on it. quick note — observed one backtrace from core: ```#0 0x7f3d2a1 in attention_forward+0x2a1
#1 0x4f9b0c in model_infer+0x1cc
#2 0x7ffdf3 in worker_loop+0x5d```

jun (ml-oncall): possible root cause hypothesis: quant attention kernel has a write-after-free on certain long-context batched prefixes causing memory corruption and eventual OOM kill.

aaron (oncall): customer impact summary for pager: ~2% of production requests affected, median increased latency for affected routes 30-120s before timeout. No data exfiltration. Logged as incident INC-2026-0410.

customer-success: notifying enterprise customers on list A with templated status; advising retry/backoff and optional switch to dedicated capacity if persistent.

priya (sre-lead): immediate stable state achieved? Current metrics: error rate 2.1%, 95th latency back to baseline. Remaining actions: full node drain complete -> migrating pods to fresh instances with quant kernels disabled, run canary with small percentage of traffic, then either revert or keep disabled.

marta (eng-runtime): drain finished. spinning up new runners with quant disabled and extra memory reservation. canary 5% -> healthy.

aaron (oncall): handing off to priya for post-incident lead. priya, please include: timeline, mitigations, customer-impact, and remediation (fix kernel bug, add memory cap per-pod, strengthen canary for kernel changes).

priya (sre-lead): taking over. ETA for full RCA & mitigation PR: 48h. immediate remediation actions: roll back quant kernel to staging for further fuzzing, add runtime guard in model-runner to kill bad allocations early, add alert for KV cache growth above 50% of pod memory.

marta (eng-runtime): creating tracking PR now -> https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/5123. includes kernel rollback, guard, and extended unit tests.

support-ops: updating status page: "partial degradation resolved; some customers saw timeouts between 03:18-03:28 UTC. We are continuing to monitor." :white_check_mark:

priya (sre-lead): handoff note for next oncall: watch for recurrence on other node pools and rollback any auto-upgrades that touched quant kernel. contact list: @marta, @jun, @aaron.

customer-success: will follow up with impacted customers with the incident summary and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: resolved -> postmortem task queued (INC-2026-0410).

priya (sre-lead): closing slack handover. thanks team, great triage. :thumbsup:
